contents:
[[bench]]
name = "categories"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "grapheme_clusters"
harness = false

[package]
name = "finl_unicode"
version = "1.3.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-DFS-2016"
keywords = [ "unicode", "segmentation", "graphemes",]
categories = [ "text-processing", "internationalization",]
description = "Library for handling Unicode functionality for finl (categories and grapheme segmentation)"
homepage = "https://finl.xyz"
repository = "https://github.com/dahosek/finl_unicode"
exclude = [ "resources",]

[dependencies]

[dev-dependencies]
unicode_categories = "0.1.1"
unicode-segmentation = "1.12.0"
bstr = "1.10.0"

[features]
default = [ "categories", "grapheme_clusters", "std",]
std = []
categories = []
grapheme_clusters = []

[build-dependencies]

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.5.1"
features = [ "html_reports",]

[dev-dependencies.finl_unicode]
path = "."
features = [ "grapheme_clusters", "categories",]

[[example]]
name = "example"
path = "examples/example.rs"

[package]
name = "xcb-imdkit"
version = "0.3.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "LGPL-2.1-only"
description = "Wrapper around xcb-imdkit, providing an IME client for the XIM protocol using XCB"
homepage = "https://github.com/wezterm/xcb-imdkit-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/wezterm/xcb-imdkit-rs"
readme = "Readme.md"
keywords = [ "ffi", "xcb", "x11", "ime", "xim",]
categories = [ "api-bindings", "gui", "text-processing",]

[lib]
name = "xcb_imdkit"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
bitflags = "1.3"
parking_lot = "0.12.3"

[build-dependencies]
cc = "1.0"
pkg-config = "0.3.19"

[features]
use-system-lib = []

[dependencies.xcb]
version = "1.3"
features = [ "xkb",]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/wez/finl_unicode"]
git = "https://github.com/wez/finl_unicode"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "no_std"

[source."https://github.com/wezterm/xcb-imdkit-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/wezterm/xcb-imdkit-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "212330f7c6c37794d78061a773e8f4f9e4785bbb"
